About The Program
What Is the PhD Program?
The PhD in chemical, process control or materials Engineering is a rigorous, research-driven doctoral degree built on substantial coursework, seminars, ethics training and a defended thesis. Our program culminates in a capstone of leadership and independent research, preparing you to become a top-tier expert in the field.
Why Choose This Program
Choose this program for its exceptional research breadth—spanning reaction kinetics, molecular modeling, process control and advanced metallurgy—supported by leading facilities and industry partnerships. You’ll benefit from one-on-one mentorship, interdisciplinary collaboration and a proven track record of innovation in solving complex engineering challenges.

Program Objectives
Master advanced research methods: Gain deep expertise in specialized engineering domains through advanced coursework, seminars and original research.
Solve real-world problems: Develop critical thinking and technical skills to tackle complex challenges in energy, materials, process optimization and sustainability.
Innovate for industry and academia: Advance new techniques, materials or control strategies with tangible impact.
Conduct independent investigations: Engage in meaningful research under expert faculty supervision, culminating in a defended thesis.
Collaborate across disciplines: Work within multidisciplinary teams to foster innovation and practical breakthroughs.
Uphold ethical research standards: Embrace ethics, professionalism and societal responsibility in all research activities.These should be bullet-point sentences:
Learning Outcomes
Master specialized expertise: Master a substantial body of knowledge at the forefront of a discipline.
Develop disciplinary awareness: Acknowledge the limitations of your work and the value of other disciplines.
Lead advanced original research: Design and implement advanced research to generate new knowledge.
Model ethical and responsible research: Uphold the highest standards of research integrity, ethics and societal responsibility, ensuring biomedical advancements benefit patients and communities globally
Effective Communication: Communicate complex ideas clearly to diverse audiences.
Careers
Graduates of the thesis-based PhD are well-positioned to lead groundbreaking research in academia, government labs, or industry R&D centers. Many continue into postdoctoral roles, faculty positions, or strategic technical leadership in sectors such as energy, materials, automation, or sustainability.
University professor or academic researcher
Research and development scientist in energy, materials or process control industries
Senior process control engineer
Innovation and technology consultant
Government or national lab research director
Postdoctoral researcher in advanced engineering topics
